name: Magic Unfolding
summary: Magic Unfolding is an absurd yet simple game made on RPG Maker 2003 about a cat-like creature, Guz, who finds an indescribable object of infinite power with the same name as the game title. Guz must save his parents from a hostile universe of pure suffering, evil, and confusion. The game may take from 3 to 7 hours to complete. It is inspired by the strange games the developer has found in the corners of the internet, and tries to embody their absurdist essence. Much of the writing is stream-of-consciousness, with poetry, gibberish, and enlightening riddles of wisdom all chaotically intermixed.
